# Corentin Michel — Senior Scientific Computing Engineer (Python) · Technical Lead

> Software engineer specialised in scientific computing and reactor physics (neutronics): Python codes for the safety and optimisation of nuclear reactor cores (ODYSSÉE calculation chain, EMC2-E operating scheme). Technical lead within the team since 2025: follow-up of the development contract, specifications and bid analysis for 2027-2030, technical-debt management with the other teams. Used to complex industrial calculation chains and to industrialising code in constrained environments; strongly involved in associations, open source and Linux.

## Experience

- Nov 2022 – present — Senior Core &amp; Fuel Engineer · UNIE/GECC/SED, EDF (Lyon · France)
- Mar – Aug 2022 — Master's thesis engineering intern · DT/PRC/CM, EDF (Lyon · France)
- Sep 2021 – Feb 2022 — Industrial project, Assystem (Montrouge · France)
- May – Aug 2021 — Research assistant in a Nuclear Physics laboratory at the DESIREE accelerator, Stockholm University (Stockholm · Sweden)
- Jul – Aug 2020 — Research assistant in a Nuclear Physics laboratory at GANIL (joint CEA/CNRS laboratory), GANIL (Caen · France)
- 2019 – 2022 — Reservist in the French National Gendarmerie, French National Gendarmerie (Caen · France)
